headline: Stema Landing Flares Up as Island Clashes and Frontline Meatgrinders Rage
war_summary: Since the previous edition, fighting has flared sharply across Stema Landing, where four strategic base actions over the last two hours have centered on the contested outpost at The Wane. Severe coastal friction also persists in Fisherman's Row, posting three fresh actions across Peripti Landing and Dankana Post, while an earlier strike on Tempest Island left Blackwatch deserted in no-man's-land. Action across Godcrofts and Lykos Isle has noticeably slackened after earlier skirmishes, allowing local garrisons a brief respite. On the mainland, no strategic strongholds changed hands, yet attritional warfare has intensified at a blistering pace: Dead Lands, Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, and Linn of Mercy report massive casualty accelerations, with thousands falling under relentless frontal assaults and sustained artillery duels across the central front.
